title: Global compute universe source manifest
purpose: Source registry for the broader database surface. These universes are kept non-additive and source-labeled; conservative entity resolution links overlaps without claiming a worldwide census.

sources.name: Epoch AI
sources.notes: Current explorer records are preserved locally. Epoch's own global-compute coverage estimate is a capacity-coverage measure, not a facility-count census.

sources.name: Compute Atlas
sources.notes: Includes data centers, crypto-mining sites and dedicated power-generation records. The database keeps facilityType so these populations are not silently mixed.

sources.name: Data Center Index
sources.notes: The free file contains 901 tracked rows, including 702 counted campuses and rows for phases/buildings/power assets/programs that the publisher does not count as campuses.

coverage_semantics.unique_view: Conservative name-plus-place matching. A match is a link between source records, not proof that two records are the same legal entity when source identity is ambiguous.
coverage_semantics.missing_fields: A blank or unavailable field is not treated as zero or absence.
coverage_semantics.global_completeness: No public source used here establishes a complete worldwide census. The objective is broader source coverage with explicit provenance and uncertainty.
